headline: Wardens Reclaim Stonecradle Post; Wind Hills Goes Colonial
war_summary: Two fronts moved in the latest returns. The Wind Hills in Mooring County is now under Colonial control, leaving that county eleven Warden posts against one Colonial outpost. Stonecradle’s lone neutral post is occupied once more; the region now stands six Colonial to three Warden, with Buckler Sound, The Reach and The Heir’s Knife still filling the event ledger. Linn Mercy retains all eleven posts for the Colonials, yet remains noisy: Lathair and Rotdust recorded eleven entries apiece in the past day, and the last two hours added three more. Stlican Shelf is split six Warden to three Colonial, Thornhold again the busy point. Weathered Expanse holds at six Warden, three Colonial; casualties passed eleven thousand on each side in a day, with Crow’s Nest the most active strongpoint. Farranac Coast stands two Warden to nine Colonial after earlier exchanges at Transient Valley and The Bone Haft. Elsewhere the strategic-base wire is quiet; no faction has yet been declared victor.
